signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Start organizing your collection. It's free.
signUp.terms: I accept the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to keep up with your collection.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot your password?
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create a new one.
forgotPassword.neutralNote: For your security, we always show this message, whether or not an account exists for that email.
forgotPassword.success: We've sent a password reset email if this email is registered with PandaTrack. Check your inbox and spam folder to continue.
forgotPassword.locked: We've sent a password reset email if this email is registered with PandaTrack. Check your inbox and spam folder to continue.
forgotPassword.sentWithCooldown: We've sent a password reset email if this email is registered with PandaTrack. Check your inbox and spam folder. If you need another one, wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
forgotPassword.cooldownNotice: We've already sent a reset link for this email recently. Use the latest email in your inbox and wait {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} before requesting another.
forgotPassword.error: We couldn't process your request. Please try again.
forgotPassword.retryLater: We couldn't send the reset email right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.description: Choose a password you don't use anywhere else.
resetPassword.helper: This reset link can only be used once and expires after 60 minutes.
resetPassword.error: We couldn't reset your password. Please try again.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link is not valid
resetPassword.invalidDescription: The link may be expired, broken, or already used. Request a new reset email and try again.
resetPassword.successDescription: Your password was updated successfully. Sign in with your new password.

errors.userAlreadyExists: An account with this email already exists.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verificationBanner.title: Verify your email
verificationBanner.description: You can use PandaTrack for 7 days without verifying your email. After that, verification is required.
verificationBanner.resendSuccess: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verificationBanner.resendError: We couldn't send the verification email. Please try again.

verifyGate.title: Verify your email to continue
verifyGate.description: Your 7-day trial has ended. Verify your email to keep using PandaTrack.
verifyGate.helpText: You will stay signed in while you complete verification.
verifyGate.resendSuccess: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verifyGate.resendError: We couldn't send the verification email. Please try again.

verifyEmailStatus.expiredDescription: Verification links are only valid for a limited time. Request a new email and try again.
verifyEmailStatus.invalidTitle: This verification link is not valid
verifyEmailStatus.invalidDescription: The link may be broken or already used. Request a new verification email and try again.
verifyEmailStatus.linkExpiryNote: Can't find it? Check spam or promotions. The link expires in 60 minutes.
verifyEmailStatus.resendSuccess: Verification email sent. Check your inbox.
verifyEmailStatus.resendError: We couldn't send the verification email. Please try again.
verifyEmailStatus.signInTitle: Sign in to request a new verification link
verifyEmailStatus.signInDescription: To resend the verification email, sign in to your account first.

verificationEmail.subject: Verify your email for {appName}
verificationEmail.title: Verify your email
verificationEmail.intro: Confirm your email to keep your account secure and private sections available.
verificationEmail.body: This link lets you finish account verification and continue using PandaTrack without interruptions.
verificationEmail.fallback: If the button does not work, use this link:
verificationEmail.footer: You received this email because a PandaTrack account was created or updated with this address.

passwordResetEmail.subject: Reset your {appName} password
passwordResetEmail.title: Create a new password
passwordResetEmail.intro: Use the secure link below to reset your password. For your security, it expires in 60 minutes.
passwordResetEmail.body: If you did not request this change, you can ignore this email and your password will stay the same.
passwordResetEmail.fallback: If the button does not work, use this link:
passwordResetEmail.footer: You received this email because a password reset was requested for your PandaTrack account.

emailChangeSecurityEmail.subject: Your {appName} email is being changed
emailChangeSecurityEmail.text: Someone requested to change the email address for your {appName} account to {newEmail}. If this was you, no further action is needed. If you did not request this change, please contact us at {supportEmail}.
emailChangeSecurityEmail.title: Email change requested
emailChangeSecurityEmail.intro: Someone requested to change the email address for your PandaTrack account.
emailChangeSecurityEmail.bodyAfterNew: . If this was you, no further action is needed. If you did not request this change, please contact us at
emailChangeSecurityEmail.footer: You received this email because a change was requested for your PandaTrack account.
